steps.en: The officer opens a search screen for outstanding-warrant records
steps.id: Officer membuka layar pencarian record warrant yang belum selesai
steps.why_en: Only the general notice search exists; the warrant list it should search does not.
steps.why_id: Hanya ada pencarian notice umum; daftar warrant yang harus dicari tidak ada.

steps.en: The officer can search by ID number
steps.id: Officer bisa mencari dengan nomor ID
steps.why_en: Searches general notices, not the outstanding-warrant list.
steps.why_id: Mencari notice umum, bukan daftar warrant outstanding.

steps.en: The officer can search by notice number
steps.id: Officer bisa mencari dengan nomor notice
steps.why_en: Searches general notices, not the outstanding-warrant list.
steps.why_id: Mencari notice umum, bukan daftar warrant outstanding.

steps.en: The officer can search by warrant number
steps.id: Officer bisa mencari dengan nomor warrant
steps.why_en: The search field exists, but the warrant data behind it is not in the code.
steps.why_id: Field pencarian ada, tetapi data warrant di belakangnya tidak ada di code.

steps.en: The officer can search by summons number
steps.id: Officer bisa mencari dengan nomor summons
steps.why_en: The field exists but the summons search is skipped outside staging.
steps.why_id: Field ada tetapi pencarian summons dilewati di luar staging.

steps.en: The officer can search by a house visit date range
steps.id: Officer bisa mencari dengan rentang tanggal kunjungan rumah
steps.why_en: No house visit date filter exists; the nearest one filters by notice date.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada filter tanggal kunjungan rumah; yang terdekat memfilter tanggal notice.

steps.en: Matching outstanding-warrant records are listed for the officer
steps.id: Record warrant outstanding yang cocok ditampilkan ke officer
steps.why_en: Results are general notices; no outstanding-warrant records exist to list.
steps.why_id: Hasilnya notice umum; tidak ada record warrant outstanding untuk ditampilkan.
